segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 62 seats and make sure it lines up with your May 20 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. I saw the quote come through. The seat count is right for phase one, but I want to confirm we can add the service desk team later without redoing the whole contract.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, exactly. The agreement has a co-termed add-on clause, so if you add, say, 18 more users in August, billing just prorates those through the same renewal date, which is June 30 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that helps. On the invoice, our finance team needs the implementation fee split out from the subscription. Is that how it will show?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It will. The subscription is $47,120 for the year, and implementation is a separate one-time line at $6,800. I already noted that in the billing tool, so the invoice should reflect it cleanly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. We also need net 45 payment terms. The draft says net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I caught that after sending. I checked with deal desk this morning, and net 45 is approved. I’ll send the revised order form after this call.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. For onboarding, can we still start the admin training the week of May 6?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. We have two sessions held for you: May 7 at 11 Eastern and May 9 at 2 Eastern. The project lead will send the prep checklist once the order form is signed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. If you send the corrected version today, I can route it for signature and probably get it back by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I’ll send it in the next hour with the updated payment terms and the invoice note. Once it’s signed, we’ll open the implementation workspace and confirm the training invites.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, thanks. That should be everything on my side.
